entities.summary: Clayton Daniel Bellinger is an American former professional baseball player. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the New York Yankees and the Anaheim Angels, winning the World Series twice as a member of the Yankees. He was also on the 2002 Angels team that won the 2002 World Series but did not receive a championship ring since he only appeared in 2 regular season games.
